findings.title: 13 text node(s) below WCAG contrast (4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large).
findings.description: 13 text node(s) below WCAG contrast (4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large). Examples: span.text-ink-faint "/" (2.49:1); span.text-ink-muted.text-sm "Do-Nothing Calculator" (4.38:1); span.text-xs.text-ink-faint "No data stored. All calculations run loc" (2.49:1).
findings.recommendation: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio reaches 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).

findings.title: 20 pointer target(s) smaller than M3's comfortable 48×48px at 1440px wide
findings.description: 20 pointer target(s) smaller than M3's comfortable 48×48px at 1440px wide — they clear the WCAG 2.5.8 24px minimum. Examples: button.text-xs.font-semibold "$100" (51×26px); button.text-xs.font-semibold "$200" (53×26px); button.text-xs.font-semibold "$500" (53×26px). Measured at the 1440×900px desktop viewport.
findings.recommendation: Fix it once in the shared style or component that produces it, so every instance changes together.

findings.title: Missing landmark(s): main, nav, contentinfo.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing landmark elements (main, nav, header, footer) so assistive tech can navigate the page.

findings.title: 9 distinct text colors
findings.description: 9 distinct text colors — color fragmentation (M3 uses a small set of on-* roles).
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to a small token set: define CSS variables for the sanctioned values and replace ad-hoc ones.

The onl" (14px). Measured at the 1440×900px desktop viewport.
findings.recommendation: Raise reading copy to at least 16px (12px absolute minimum for any text).

notAutoDetectable: Spatial coherence — whether elements enter/exit from where they logically belong (a menu growing from its anchor, a sheet rising from the edge it docks to). The audit sees durations and easings, not spatial origin.
Clean fades — whether opacity transitions are free of mid-fade color shifts, banding, or double-compositing. Only a human eye (or pixel diff) can judge fade quality.
Jump cuts — abrupt state changes with no transition where one is expected (content swaps, route changes). Absence of animation is not itself in the DOM.
Unified direction — whether a group of elements animates along a consistent axis/choreography rather than each doing its own thing.
Perceived hierarchy / emphasis — whether motion draws the eye to the right thing at the right time.
Content-appropriate personality — expressive vs. standard scheme being the right call for the brand and context.
Interruptibility & continuity — whether in-flight animations respond gracefully to new input rather than snapping.
Real contrast under imagery/gradients — text over photos or gradient backgrounds (the audit samples solid computed backgrounds only).
Closed shadow roots — their internals are structurally unreachable from script and are not scanned.

extras.title: Primary controls show no hover feedback
extras.description: 6 of 6 sampled primary controls showed no visual change on hover (CCense, $100, $200).
extras.recommendation: Add :hover feedback (background, color, or elevation change) to interactive elements.
